100STYLE.label: 100STYLE
100STYLE.origin: The 100STYLE dataset: one performer walking, running, sidestepping and idling in 100 styles, captured by Ian Mason, Sebastian Starke and Taku Komura (Real-Time Style Modelling of Human Locomotion via Feature-Wise Transformations and Local Motion Phases, 2022). Each clip is a forward run cut at its best cycle (a stride: two steps), inside the frames the dataset marks as the style.
